# Why

R Markdown files are plain text, so GitHub shows the source and knitting runs
the code. Inline values like `r nrow(df)` and `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y")` stay
literal here.

```{r child="setup.Rmd"}
```

# Chunks that vanish or stay

```{r hidden, echo=FALSE}
df <- read.csv("private.csv")
```

```{r shown, echo=TRUE, fig.width=6, fig.cap="A caption, with a comma"}
summary(cars)
```

```{r notrun, eval=FALSE}
saveRDS(model, "model.rds")
```

```{python py-chunk}
import math
print(math.pi)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
secret <- 42
```

```{sql, include=FALSE}
SELECT * FROM users;
```

```{=html}
<div class="callout">Raw HTML block, passed through.</div>
```
